tools.name: lookup_manifest
tools.description: Looks up the SHA-256 of an evidence package's manifest.json in ProofSnap's public ledger: whether ProofSnap issued exactly this manifest, and when. It covers packages issued by the ProofSnap API and dashboard; packages made with the browser extension are not in this ledger.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "lookup_manifest" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
